# `irs527_form8872`

**IRS Form 8872 Section 527 periodic reports**

IRS Form 8872 political organization report of contributions and expenditures (record type 2) from PolOrgsFullData.zip, with exact decimal totals and literal source fields.

**Coverage.** Not a range. All record-type-2 periodic reports (Form 8872) present in the captured IRS Section 527 PolOrgsFullData.zip archive. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `irs527_form8872.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
